## Selected Projects
- [FoodWise](https://github.com/Sudhanshu-22-11/FoodWise): AI-driven circular food waste management, industrial mass balance, and verified community hunger relief platform. Live at https://food-wise-puce.vercel.app.
- [Exam Guardrail](https://github.com/Sudhanshu-22-11/Exam-Guardrail): Integrity-first online examination monitoring system with candidate environment enforcement and live proctor surveillance (Team BrainBytes).
- [ResQ-AI](https://github.com/Sudhanshu-22-11/ResQ-AI): Emergency first-response hybrid app and PWA featuring offline-first triage trees, CPR metronome, and 2-second hold-to-SOS.
- [Unified Tribal Scholarship](https://github.com/Sudhanshu-22-11/sih-unified-tribal-scholarship): Aakanksha — Unified Tribal Scholarship Portal prototype for the Ministry of Tribal Affairs (Smart India Hackathon 2026).
